# Security signs. The document changes while the others read. The sign-off binds to the old version, so the tally lists it as stale and the
# security role is missing again. The ledger keeps the row. The brief agent gets the diff, the roles are told about the new version,
# and the approval is for the new version.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:ssh-keygen] skip
[!exec:sqlite3] skip
[!exec:flock] skip
[!exec:git] skip
[!exec:sha256sum] [!exec:shasum] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

approvalsinit
approvalsfakes
approvalskeys ann sam pat
subst home/.approval/config
env HOME=$WORK/home
env APPROVALS_DIR=$WORK/ops
env APPROVALS_WINDOW_SECONDS=300
env APPROVAL_POLL=1

exec sh ops/scripts/submit.sh msa msa.md ann
exec obeereal item add approvals req-1 --title 'Release' --body-file body.txt
exec obeereal run req-1 approvals --workflow ops/workflow.star &
waitfile notices.log
exec signoff sam security approve req-1 msa
exec sh ops/scripts/tally.sh req-1
stdout '"security":\{[^}]*"approved":\["sam"\]'
exec sh ops/scripts/submit.sh msa msa-v2.md ann
waitfile prompt-brief-1.txt
exec sh ops/scripts/tally.sh req-1
stdout '"stale":\[\{"who":"sam","role":"security"'
stdout '"satisfied":0'
grep -count=1 '^brief$' calls.log
grep 'delivers in 45 days' prompt-brief-1.txt

exec signoff sam security approve req-1 msa
exec signoff pat product approve req-1 msa
wait
stdout 'item req-1 finished'
grep -count=2 '^version-req-1-' notices.log
exec sh -c 'sh ops/scripts/audit.sh req-1 $(git hash-object msa-v2.md) $(jq -r .head home/.approval/certs/req-1.json)'
stdout -count=2 '\tsignoff\tsam\tsecurity\tapprove\t'
stdout '\tclosed\t.*\tapproved\t'
exec sh -c 'git hash-object msa-v2.md > want.txt; jq -r .state.hash home/.approval/certs/req-1.json > got.txt'
cmp got.txt want.txt

-- body.txt --
{"doc":"msa","kind":"release","author":"ann"}
-- msa.md --
The supplier delivers in 30 days.
-- msa-v2.md --
The supplier delivers in 45 days.
-- home/.approval/config --
NOTIFY_API=http://notify.test
-- home/.approval/credential.header --
Authorization: Bearer TESTONLY
